about: Plain words for the Louvain communities, written by hand from terms.json (each community's enriched terms, FDR < 0.05, from the authors' Enrichr tables significant_enrichment_*_louvain_cluster_fdr.pickle). Keys are the authors' community ids (top: the 125 of the dendrogram's top level, numbered by size; mid: the 152; fine: the 456). Only what the terms support; 'mixed' where the terms are general (signalling, metabolism, disease) or absent. A community left out has no label: the app shows its top term instead. Check a label against terms.json before changing it.

top.1: mixed: cell signals and cell death
